task: Loud foreground alerts + escalation-until-ack + enhanced web push for per-load dispatch chat. Non-financial, Tier-3. No migration, no chat schema change, reuse existing confirmation_ack path.
details: A1 driver PWA foreground loud alert: LoudAlertEngine (Web Audio looping tone + navigator.vibrate loop, autoplay-safe) + LoudAlertOverlay full-screen takeover (Acknowledge-only) + LoudAlertWatcher (global mount, polling 15s/5s) that posts the EXISTING confirmation_ack path

A2 service worker: showNotification now sets requireInteraction + renotify + per-thread tag + vibrate; notificationclick deep-links chat pushes to /chat?threadId=... (sw.ts source + regenerated public/sw.js + page-side notification-handler resolver in sync)

A3 escalation-until-ack cron (chat-confirmation-escalation.cron.ts): finds stale unacked confirmation_requests (no confirmation_ack; read receipt != ack), re-fires web push on the CHAT_ESCALATION_CONFIG schedule (staleAfterMinutes 2 / intervals 2,5,10 / maxAttempts 3), appends events.log_event per attempt (spine, subject load/driver), in-memory bounded retries (no migration); office UNACKNOWLEDGED badge via read-only listThreads derivation

A5 tests: selectEscalations selector unit test (unacked+stale selected, acked excluded, read-but-unacked STILL selected) + loud-alert-controller dismissal-invariant test (takeover clears only via acknowledge) + static guard verify:notif-a-contract
ios_note: Locked+silent iOS gets only a system-volume web-push notification (no custom looping tone / requireInteraction is honored best-effort). A truly can't-ignore alert on a locked iPhone requires the future native NOTIF-B app.
